integrity: The unrestricted theorem has a direct finite-field counting proof; small enumerations are supporting checks rather than a proof. No external independent audit is asserted.
limitations: This determines only the first two moments of the nonzero idempotent count; odd-characteristic higher moments and full distribution are not asserted. It does not establish the generic Galois-group conjecture.
title: Exact finite-field variance of idempotents in random perfect evolution algebras
